verdict.rationale: Crossplane's architecture is explicitly built around a Provider package system that connects to arbitrary external APIs (docs-10), with a concrete AWS RDS example (docs-3) and community discussion confirming providers exist for AWS, GCP, Azure, and beyond, contrasting Crossplane's portability with single-cloud operators (comm-1, comm-4). This directly supports the multi-cloud/SaaS provider ecosystem story, though evidence is docs-heavy with limited independent verification of SaaS-provider breadth.
